Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_TEMPLATE_ID
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** this is where we validate template id.
** Default template id is DEFAULT, but when a sponsor
** specific template is created, then it takes the id
** which is equivalent of sponsor id
*/

declare
 id_lov LOV;
 h_lov_reply boolean;
 n_count number;

 cursor cur_template is 
 select name
 from sponsors
 where sponsor_id = :ctrl_block.template_id
 /* and eff_date <= sysdate 
 and nvl( term_date, sysdate + 1) > sysdate; */
 and eff_date <= :local_date 
 and nvl( term_date, to_date(:local_date) + 1) > :local_date
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;

begin
 if :ctrl_block.template_id is null then
 show_error('0080');
-- show_error('18086');
 check_package_failure;
/*
 elsif :global.no_default_template = 'TRUE' then
 :ctrl_block.template_id := 'DEFAULT';
*/
 end if;

 id_lov := find_lov('template_lov');
 if id_null(id_lov) then
 show_error('11008');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.template_id != 'DEFAULT' then
 /*
 ** validate sponsor id against sponsors table
 */
 open cur_template;
 fetch cur_template
 into :ctrl_block.template_description;
 if cur_template%NOTFOUND then
 begin
 close cur_template;
 select count(*)
 into n_count 
 from sponsors
 where name like :ctrl_block.template_id || '%'
 /*
 and eff_date <= sysdate 
 and nvl( term_date, sysdate + 1) > sysdate;*/
 and eff_date <= :local_date 
 and nvl( term_date, to_date(:local_date) + 1) > :local_date
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 if n_count = 1 then
 select sponsor_id, name
 into :ctrl_block.template_id, :ctrl_block.template_description
 from sponsors
 where name like :ctrl_block.template_id || '%'
 /*
 and eff_date <= sysdate 
 and nvl( term_date, sysdate + 1) > sysdate;*/
 and eff_date <= :local_date 
 and nvl( term_date, to_date(:local_date) + 1) > :local_date
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 elsif n_count > 1 then
 h_lov_reply := show_lov(id_lov);
 if h_lov_reply = FALSE then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 elsif n_count = 0 then
 show_error('11047');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 else
 close cur_template;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** retrieve description for action code
*/
declare
 h_rtn_num number := 0 ;

 cursor cur_actcd is
 select description
 from valid_master_codes
 where code = :default_checklist_template.action_code
 and code_type = 'ACTCD';

begin
 begin
 if :default_checklist_template.action_code is not null then
 open cur_actcd;
 fetch cur_actcd into :default_checklist_template.action_code_description;

 if cur_actcd%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_actcd;
 show_error('11002');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 close cur_actcd;
 end if;
 end;

 if :default_checklist_template.action_flag = '1' then
 :default_checklist_template.target_date_status := 'FIXED';
 else
 :default_checklist_template.target_date_status := 'FLOATING';
 end if;

 if :default_checklist_template.time_flag = 'AD' then
 :default_checklist_template.time_line := 'After Drive';
 elsif :default_checklist_template.time_flag = 'BD' then
 :default_checklist_template.time_line := 'Before Drive';
 elsif :default_checklist_template.time_flag = 'CD' then
 :default_checklist_template.time_line := 'After Creation';
 elsif :default_checklist_template.time_flag = 'DD' then
 :default_checklist_template.time_line := 'On Drive Date';
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** this is where we let user enter a action code and then validate it
** against valid_master_codes
*/
declare
 h_rtn_num number;

 cursor cur_actcd is
 select description, decode(numeral_value, 1, 'FIXED', 'FLOATING'), 
 eff_date, term_date
 from valid_master_codes
 where code = :drive_checklist_template.action_code
 and code_type = 'ACTCD'
 and code not in ( 
 select action_code 
 from drive_checklist_template 
 where sponsor_id = 'DEFAULT' )
 and nvl( term_date, sysdate + 1 ) > sysdate;

begin
 if :drive_checklist_template.action_code is not null then
 begin
 if :drive_checklist_template.action_code is not null then
 open cur_actcd;
 fetch cur_actcd 
 into :drive_checklist_template.action_code_description, 
 :drive_checklist_template.target_date_status, 
 :drive_checklist_template.eff_date, 
 :drive_checklist_template.term_date;

 if cur_actcd%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_actcd;
 show_error('11321');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 close cur_actcd;
 end if;
 end;
 :drive_checklist_template.sort_seq := :system.cursor_record;
 end if;
-- message( 'Old Action code - ' || :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code ); pause;
-- message( 'New Action code - ' || :drive_checklist_template.action_code ); pause;
 if :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code != 
 :drive_checklist_template.action_code then
 if :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code is not null then
 /*
 ** Its not a fresh entry, so exists in record group 
 ** delete from the record group before inserting the new one
 */
-- message( 'Old Action code not null - ' || :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code ); pause;
 check_insert_rg( 'RG_CHECK_ACTION', 'C05', 
 :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code || ',', 'D', h_rtn_num );
 if ( h_rtn_num != 0 and h_rtn_num != 99999 ) then
 show_error( '11321' );
 check_package_failure;
 elsif h_rtn_num = 99999 then
 show_error( '11320' );
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 if ( :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code is null 
 or (:drive_checklist_template.old_action_code != 
 :drive_checklist_template.action_code)) then 
 /*
 ** populate the record group with new entry
 */
-- message( 'New Action code - ' || :drive_checklist_template.action_code ); pause;
 check_insert_rg( 'RG_CHECK_ACTION', 'C05', 
 :drive_checklist_template.action_code || ',', 'U', h_rtn_num );
-- message( to_char( h_rtn_num ) ); pause;
 if ( h_rtn_num != 0 and h_rtn_num != 99999 ) then
 show_error( '11321' );
 check_package_failure;
 elsif h_rtn_num = 99999 then
 show_error( '11320' );
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

** against valid_master_codes

 /*
 ** Its not a fresh entry, so exists in record group 
 ** delete from the record group before inserting the new one
 */
-- message( 'Old Action code not null - ' || :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code ); pause;
 nRowNum := find_record_group_item( 'RG_CHECK_ACTION', 'CODE', 1, null, 
 :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code );
 message( to_char( nRowNum ) ); pause;
 if ( nRowNum > 0 and nRowNum != 99999 ) then
 delete_group_row( 'RG_CHECK_ACTION', nRowNum );
 elsif nRowNum = 99999 then
 show_error( '11320' );
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 if ( :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code is null 
 or (:drive_checklist_template.old_action_code != 
 :drive_checklist_template.action_code)) then 
 /*
 ** populate the record group with new entry
 */

 show_error( '9199' );

 show_error( '11320' );
 check_package_failure;
 elsif nRowNum = 0 then
 add_group_row( 'RG_CHECK_ACTION', END_OF_GROUP );
 curr_group_row := get_group_row_count( 'RG_CHECK_ACTION' );
 set_group_char_cell( 'RG_CHECK_ACTION.CODE', curr_group_row, :drive_checklist_template.action_code );
 end if;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRREC

declare

begin
 /*
 ** fixed time line records cannot be deleted.
 */
 if :drive_checklist_template.target_date_status = 'FIXED' then
 show_error('11052');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 /*
 ** Its not a fresh entry, so exists in record group 
 ** delete from the record group before clearing the record
 */
 sActionCode := nvl( :drive_checklist_template.action_code, 
 :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code );
-- message( sActionCode ); pause;
 if sActionCode is not null then
 check_insert_rg( 'RG_CHECK_ACTION', 'C05', 
 sActionCode || ',', 'D', h_rtn_num );
 if ( h_rtn_num != 0 and h_rtn_num != 99999 ) then
 show_error( '11321' );
 check_package_failure;
 elsif h_rtn_num = 99999 then
 show_error( '11320' );
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 clear_record;
end;

BEGIN
 /*

 id_rg := find_group('MULTI_SELECT_TMP');

 if :vmc_block.select_chk = 'Y' then

 set_group_char_cell('MULTI_SELECT_TMP.CODE', curr_group_row, :vmc_block.code);

 else
 next_record;

 end loop;
 go_record(ref_record_number);
 go_item('drive_checklist_template.target_days');
 end;
-- synchronize;

ProgramUnit.Name: FIND_RECORD_GROUP_ITEM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION FIND_RECORD_GROUP_ITEM 
( sRecordGroupName IN VARCHAR2, 
 sRecordGroupColumnName IN VARCHAR2, 
 nStartRowNum IN NUMBER,
 nEndRowNum IN NUMBER,
 sSearchValue IN VARCHAR2 )
RETURN NUMBER IS
/*
** Return values are
** 0 = Not found
** Valid Number = Row number where search string found
** 99999 = No record group found
** -1 = Internal error
*/
 id_rg RecordGroup;
 id_gc GroupColumn;
 nGroupRowCount number;
 nFound number;
 nStart number;
 nEnd number;

BEGIN
 /*
 ** get the record group with user selection
 */
 if sSearchValue is null then
 return 0; -- No record found !!!
 end if;
-- message( sRecordGroupName ); pause;
 id_rg := find_group( in_quotes( sRecordGroupName ) );
 if not id_null( id_rg ) then
 return 99999; -- No record group found !!!
 end if;

 nGroupRowCount := get_group_row_count( id_rg );

 id_gc := find_column( '''' || sRecordGroupName || '.' || sRecordGroupColumnName || '''' );

 nStart := nStartRowNum;
 nEnd := nEndRowNum;
 if ( nStart < 1 or nStart is null )then
 nStart := 1;
 end if;

 if ( nEnd < 1 or nEnd is null )then
 nEnd := nGroupRowCount;
 end if;

 if nEnd < nStart then
 nStart := nStart + nEnd;
 nEnd := nStart - nEnd;
 nStart := nStart - nEnd;
 end if;

 nFound := 0;
 for i in nStart .. nEnd loop
 if sSearchValue = get_group_char_cell( id_gc, i) then
 nFound := i;
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;

 return nFound;


EXCEPTION
 when others then
 return -1; 
END;
